title: Fill a prompt template
summary: A prompt template is reusable text with named spaces to fill. Formatting prepares the text; it does not send it anywhere.
introduction: A prompt template is reusable text with named spaces to fill. Formatting prepares the text; it does not send it anywhere. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A prompt template is reusable text with named spaces to fill. Formatting prepares the text; it does not send it anywhere.

blocks.code:
from langchain_core.prompts import PromptTemplate
prompt = PromptTemplate.from_template("Explain {topic} in {count} short sentences.")
print(prompt.format(topic="loops", count=2))
blocks.title: Fill a prompt template

blocks.text: The output is Explain loops in 2 short sentences. The values replace topic and count inside braces.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: All required template fields need values; spelling the field name differently causes an error.
